notes_for_orchestrator: Runtime hook delivery remains unverified as required; no live configuration/deployment changes. Final v1 links include nullable baseline_version for every kind; baselines require phase_id+baseline_version and nonempty goal/scope; decisions require phase_id+baseline_version+decision_id and nonempty summary/reason, optional scope_added/scope_removed. Data allowlists match root clarification. Provider tool_use_id maps to canonical tool_call_id; MCP tools collapse to MCP. Export only daily JSONL; never export private project-index. Kit must omit Codex SubagentStop until required stdout response supported. Local index corruption warns and does not silently reassign identity. The packet explicitly authorizes this result JSON in addition to the three source files.
